# Single-cell analysis 

## Read in data 

```{r read-data-batch-correction, message=FALSE}
sce <- readRDS("/mnt/central_nas/rcc_volume/RCC/IMC/myeloid_panel/data_analysis/sce_MY_03.rds")
sce
```

We will perform broad classification into epithelial and non-epithelial cells separately for ccRCC and all other subtypes.

# ccRCC 

## Read in data 

```{r read-data-batch-correction, message=FALSE}
sce <- sce[,sce$subtype_combined == "ccRCC"]
sce
```


## 1. GMM for all type-relevant markers 

```{r}
## Gaussian mixture model for all markers relevant for initial celltype assignment 
type_markers <- c("CA9","panCK","CD31_vWF","SMA","CD45RO_RA", "CD3","CD4","CD8a","CD38","MPO","CD11c","CD20", "CD68")

plot_list <- list()

library(doParallel)
registerDoParallel(cores = 20)

out_list <- foreach (x = type_markers) %dopar%{ #replace with for-loop to also access plot_list (slower)
  
  GMM_marker <- Mclust(assay(sce, "exprs")[x,], G = 2)
  
  GMM_df <- data.frame(class_marker = ifelse(GMM_marker$classification == 2 & GMM_marker$uncertainty == 0, paste0(x, "_pos"), paste0(x, "_neg")), 
                     marker_exprs = assay(sce, "exprs")[x,],
                     uncertainty = GMM_marker$uncertainty)
  
  plot_list[[x]] <- ggplot(GMM_df, aes(x = marker_exprs))+
  geom_density()+
  geom_rug(aes(color = class_marker))+
  theme_classic()+
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Set1")
  
  return(GMM_df$class_marker)
}

for (i in seq_along(out_list)){
  colData(sce)[,paste0(type_markers[i],"_GMM")] <- out_list[[i]]
}
```

Combine GMM scores into a single type score (separate for epithelial and non-epithelial cells)

```{r}
## For non_epithelial cells 

library(data.table)

# Convert the data.frame to a data.table
data_dt <- colData(sce) %>% as.data.frame %>% select("cell_id", "CD31_vWF_GMM","SMA_GMM","CD45RO_RA_GMM", "CD3_GMM","CD4_GMM","CD8a_GMM","CD38_GMM","MPO_GMM","CD11c_GMM","CD20_GMM", "CD68_GMM") %>% as.data.table()

string_to_detect <- "_pos"

# Detect pos across columns
data_dt[, Contains_String := apply(.SD, 1, function(x) any(str_detect(x, string_to_detect))), .SDcols = -"cell_id"]

#Add to sce
sce$non_epithelial_GMM <- data_dt$Contains_String[match(sce$cell_id, data_dt$cell_id)]

summary(data_dt$Contains_String)
```

```{r}
## For epithelial cells 

library(data.table)

# Convert the data.frame to a data.table
data_dt <- colData(sce) %>% as.data.frame %>% select("cell_id", "CA9_GMM","panCK_GMM") %>% as.data.table()

string_to_detect <- "_pos"

# Detect pos across columns
data_dt[, Contains_String := apply(.SD, 1, function(x) any(str_detect(x, string_to_detect))), .SDcols = -"cell_id"]

#Add to sce
sce$epithelial_GMM <- data_dt$Contains_String[match(sce$cell_id, data_dt$cell_id)]

summary(data_dt$Contains_String)
```

## 2. Perform "overclustering"

Test different channel combinations 

```{r}
rowData(sce)$broad_cluster <- rownames(sce) %in% c("CA9","panCK","CD31_vWF","SMA","CD45RO_RA", "CD3","CD4","CD8a","CD38","MPO","CD11c","CD20", "CD68")

rowData(sce)$broad_cluster_1 <- rownames(sce) %in% c("CA9","panCK", "Vimentin","CD31_vWF","SMA","CD45RO_RA", "CD3","CD4","CD8a","CD38","MPO","CD11c","CD20", "CD68")
```


Next, we will run a granular graph-based clustering algorithm (Jaccard-based weights, Louvain clustering as community detection algorithm). 


```{r}
library(Rphenoannoy)

set.seed(22)

mat <- t(assay(sce, "exprs")[rowData(sce)$broad_cluster==TRUE,])

#k=30
out <- Rphenoannoy(mat, k = 30)

clusters <- factor(membership(out[[2]]))

sce$cluster <- clusters #renamed to sce$cluster_30

unique(sce$cluster)

#Save sce after clustering
saveRDS(sce, "/mnt/central_nas/rcc_volume/RCC/IMC/myeloid_panel/data_analysis/sce_ccRCC_MY_04.rds")


#### 

set.seed(22)

mat <- t(assay(sce, "exprs")[rowData(sce)$broad_cluster_1==TRUE,])

#k=30
out <- Rphenoannoy(mat, k = 30)

clusters <- factor(membership(out[[2]]))

sce$cluster_1 <- clusters

unique(sce$cluster_1)

#Save sce_ccRCCs after clustering
saveRDS(sce, "/mnt/central_nas/rcc_volume/RCC/IMC/myeloid_panel/data_analysis/sce_ccRCC_MY_04.rds")
```

### Cluster stability testing and comparison

```{r clustree, message = FALSE, warning=FALSE}
#Read sce after clustering and GMM
#sce <- readRDS("/mnt/central_nas/rcc_volume/RCC/IMC/myeloid_panel/data_analysis/sce_ccRCC_MY_04.rds")

#Pairwise rand index 
#Agreement between two clustering approaches - ARI > 0.5 = "good" similarity
pairwiseRand(sce$cluster_30,sce$cluster_50, mode = "index")
pairwiseRand(sce$cluster_50,sce$cluster_70, mode = "index")

#Over different resolution parameters - Silhouette width [-1,1,max], Purity[0,1,max], Root-mean-squared difference [min]
clusters <- colnames(colData(sce))[str_detect(colnames(colData(sce)),"cluster_[:digit:]")]
clusters <- clusters[!clusters == "cluster_1"]

df <- foreach(i = seq_along(clusters),.combine = rbind) %do% {
num_clus <- length(unique(colData(sce)[,clusters[i]]))
sil <- approxSilhouette(t(assay(sce, "min_max")), clusters=colData(sce)[,clusters[i]])
rmsd <- clusterRMSD(t(assay(sce, "min_max")), clusters=colData(sce)[,clusters[i]])
data.frame(num_clus = num_clus,
           k = as.numeric(str_split(clusters[i],"_",simplify = TRUE)[,2]), 
           sil = mean(sil$width), 
           rmsd = sum(rmsd))
}

p1 <- ggplot(df, aes(x=k, y=num_clus))+
  geom_point(aes(k, num_clus, col = num_clus))+
  geom_line(aes(k, num_clus,col=num_clus))+
  theme_classic()+
  scale_color_continuous(type = "viridis")

p2 <- ggplot(df, aes(x=k, y=rmsd))+
  geom_point(aes(k, rmsd, col = rmsd))+
  geom_line(aes(k, rmsd,col=rmsd))+
  theme_classic()+
  scale_color_continuous(type = "viridis")

p3 <- ggplot(df, aes(x=k, y=sil))+
  geom_point(aes(k, sil, col = sil))+
  geom_line(aes(k, sil,col=sil))+
  theme_classic()+
  scale_color_continuous(type = "viridis")
  
p1+p2+p3 
```

We selected cluster_70 for downstream analysis.

## 3. Astir for automated cell type assignment 

### Astir model

see [here](https://www.sciencedirect.com/science/article/pii/S2405471221003355?via%3Dihub) for full publication (Geuenich et al.,2021, Cell Systems).

```{r astir-expo}
#Export arsinh normalized expression matrix as csv
expr_astir <- assay(sce,"exprs") %>% t() %>% as.data.frame() %>% mutate(PID = sce$PID)

write.csv(expr_astir, file = "/mnt/central_nas/rcc_volume/RCC/IMC/myeloid_panel/data_analysis/04_broad/expr_ccRCC_astir.csv",row.names = TRUE)

#Export design matrix 
design_astir <- colData(sce) %>% as.data.frame %>% select(PID)

write.csv(design_astir, file = "/mnt/central_nas/rcc_volume/RCC/IMC/myeloid_panel/data_analysis/04_broad/design_ccRCC_astir.csv",row.names = TRUE)
```

`Next: Run Astir in Python.`

```{r astir-ana, message = FALSE,warning=FALSE}
#Import Astir cell type assignments
astir_type <- read_csv("/mnt/central_nas/rcc_volume/RCC/IMC/myeloid_panel/data_analysis/04_broad/astir_ccRCC_celltypes_TME.csv",col_names = c("ID","cell_type"),skip = 1)

astir_sum <- astir_type %>% as.data.frame %>% group_by(cell_type) %>% dplyr::count()


# Add to sce
sce$astir_type <- astir_type$cell_type[match(sce$cell_id, astir_type$ID)]

# Create combined category
sce$astir_combined <- ifelse(sce$astir_type %in% c("Unknown","Other"), "Unknown/Other", ifelse(sce$astir_type == "Tumor", "Epithelial", "Non-Epithelial"))

#Mark channels used for cell type assignment 
astir_channel = c("CD3","CD4","CD8a", "CD68", "CD11c", "MPO", "CD31_vWF", "SMA", "CD38", "CA9", "panCK")

rowData(sce)$use_astir <- rowData(sce) %>% as.data.frame() %>% mutate(use_astir = ifelse(rownames(sce) %in% astir_channel,TRUE,FALSE)) %>% pull(use_astir)
```

## 4. Combine results 

### Heatmap 

Heatmap of clusters with GMM and ASTIR information 

```{r heatmap, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
#Read sce after clustering, astir and GMM
sce <- readRDS("/mnt/central_nas/rcc_volume/RCC/IMC/myeloid_panel/data_analysis/sce_ccRCC_MY_04.rds")

### 1. Heatmap body ###

# Min-Max [0,1] normalization of arcsinh-transformed counts
assay(sce, "min_max") <- assay(sce, "exprs") - rowMins(assay(sce, "exprs"))
assay(sce, "min_max") <- assay(sce, "min_max") / (rowMaxs(assay(sce, "exprs")) - rowMins(assay(sce, "exprs")))

# Aggregrate across cells with the mean
# We select cluster_70 
sce$cluster <- sce$cluster_70
mean_sce <- aggregateAcrossCells(sce, ids = sce$cluster,
                                 statistics = "mean",
                                 use.assay.type = "min_max",
                                 subset.row = rowData(sce)$broad_cluster)

# Heatmap body color 
col_main = viridis(100)

### 2. Heatmap annotation ###

### 2.1 Spatial features

#Add number of neighbors to sce object (saved in ColPair)
n_neighbors <- colPair(sce) %>% as.data.frame() %>% group_by(from) %>% dplyr::count() %>% arrange(desc(n))
sce$n_neighbors <- n_neighbors$n[match(seq_along(colnames(sce)),n_neighbors$from)]
sce$n_neighbors <- sce$n_neighbors %>% replace_na(0)

#Select spatial features and average over clusters 
spatial <- colData(sce) %>% as.data.frame %>% select(area,eccentricity,n_neighbors, cluster)
spatial <- spatial %>% select(-cluster) %>% aggregate(by = list(cluster = spatial$cluster), FUN = mean) %>% column_to_rownames("cluster")

#Define color schemes for spatial features and add to metadata
area_col <- colorRamp2(c(min(spatial$area),median(spatial$area),max(spatial$area)), c(brewer.pal(3,"Blues")[1],brewer.pal(3,"Blues")[2],brewer.pal(3,"Blues")[3]))
metadata(sce)$colors$area <- area_col

eccentricity_col <- colorRamp2(c(min(spatial$eccentricity),median(spatial$eccentricity),max(spatial$eccentricity)), c(brewer.pal(3,"Purples")[1],brewer.pal(3,"Purples")[2],brewer.pal(3,"Purples")[3]))
metadata(sce)$colors$eccentricity <- eccentricity_col

n_neighbors_col <- colorRamp2(c(min(spatial$n_neighbors),median(spatial$n_neighbors),max(spatial$n_neighbors)), c(brewer.pal(3,"RdPu")[1],brewer.pal(3,"RdPu")[2],brewer.pal(3,"RdPu")[3]))
metadata(sce)$colors$n_neighbors <- n_neighbors_col

#Create Spatial Heatmap Annotation
ha_spatial <- HeatmapAnnotation(
    area = spatial$area,
    eccentricity = spatial$eccentricity,
    n_neighbors = spatial$n_neighbors, 
    col = list(area = metadata(sce)$colors$area,
               eccentricity = metadata(sce)$colors$eccentricity,
               n_neighbors = metadata(sce)$colors$n_neighbors),
    border = TRUE,
    which = "row")

### 2.2 Metadata features

#Number of cells per cluster 
n_cells <- colData(mean_sce) %>% as.data.frame %>% select(cluster, ncells)

#GMM - non-epithelial GMM
nr_immune <- colData(sce) %>% as.data.frame %>% select(cluster, non_epithelial_GMM) %>% table()
fr_immune <- as.data.frame(nr_immune) %>% pivot_wider(names_from = non_epithelial_GMM, values_from = Freq) %>% column_to_rownames("cluster")
fr_immune <- fr_immune %>% transmute(fr_immune = `TRUE`/rowSums(fr_immune)) %>% as.data.frame()

#Astir - non-epithelial prediction
nr_astir <- colData(sce) %>% as.data.frame %>% select(cluster, astir_combined) %>% table()
fr_astir <- as.data.frame(nr_astir) %>% pivot_wider(names_from = astir_combined, values_from = Freq) %>% column_to_rownames("cluster")
fr_astir <- fr_astir %>% select(-"Unknown/Other") %>% transmute(fr_astir = `Non-Epithelial`/rowSums(fr_astir)) %>% as.data.frame()

ha_meta <- HeatmapAnnotation(GMM_NonEpi = anno_barplot(fr_immune, width = unit(12, "mm"),gp = gpar(fill = "#377EB8", col = 1)),
                            Astir_NonEpi = anno_barplot(fr_astir, width = unit(12, "mm"),gp = gpar(fill = "#377EB8", col = 1)),
                            n_cells = anno_barplot(n_cells$ncells, width = unit(10, "mm"),gp = gpar(fill = "violet", col = 1)),
                            border = TRUE, 
                            annotation_name_rot = 90,
                            gap = unit(1,"mm"),
                            which = "row")


### 3. Define tumor, mixed and stroma cluster (based on GMM_CK)
#### This step is highly important for downstream categories 

# Here we manually set the cut-off (other options that were tried are tertiles/GMM)
anno_cluscat <- fr_immune %>% 
  rownames_to_column(var = "cluster") %>%
  mutate(cluster_category = ifelse(fr_immune >= 0.75,"Non-Epithelial",ifelse(fr_immune < 0.75 & fr_immune > 0.25,"Mixed","Epithelial")))


# Set colors for clusters and cluster_category then add to metdata
cluster_col <- setNames(colorRampPalette(brewer.pal(9, "Paired"))(length(unique(anno_cluscat$cluster))),unique(anno_cluscat$cluster))
cluster_category <- setNames(c("#1F78B4", "#A6CEE3", "#B2DF8A"),sort(unique(anno_cluscat$cluster_category)))                                  
metadata(sce)$colors$cluster <- cluster_col               
metadata(sce)$colors$cluster_category <- cluster_category               

#Visualize GMM_panCK density plots
ggplot(anno_cluscat, aes(fr_immune))+
  geom_density()+
  geom_rug(aes(color = cluster_category))+
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0.75, color = "red3")+
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0.25, color = "red3")+
  theme_classic()+
  theme(axis.title.x = element_blank())+
  scale_color_manual(values = cluster_category)

ha_cluscat <- HeatmapAnnotation(cluster_category = anno_cluscat$cluster_category,
                                col = list(cluster_category = metadata(sce)$colors$cluster_category),
                                border = TRUE,
                                which = "row")


### 4. Plot combined Heatmap
h <- Heatmap(t(assay(mean_sce, "min_max")),
        col = col_main,
        name= "min-max",
        km = 1,
        show_row_names = T, 
        row_names_side = "left",
        show_column_names =  T, row_split = anno_cluscat$cluster_category,
        clustering_method_rows = "ward.D2",
        clustering_method_columns = "ward.D2")+
  ha_spatial+
  ha_meta+
  ha_cluscat

draw(h)

### Add cluster_categories to sce
sce$cluster_category <- anno_cluscat$cluster_category[match(sce$cluster,anno_cluscat$cluster)]

#Save sce
#saveRDS(sce, "/mnt/central_nas/tnbc_volume/TNBC/data_analysis/04_sce_TNBC_Clus.rds")
```

```{r}
                                 statistics = "mean",
                                 use.assay.type = "min_max",

# other markers

        km = 1,

draw(h_1)
```

### Define categories for downstream analysis

Use all non-epithelial clusters and mixed clusters with non-epithelial prediction for downstream immune analysis.

```{r ana_cat, message = FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(easyalluvial)

sce$analysis_cat <- colData(sce) %>% as.data.frame %>% 
  select(cluster_category, astir_combined) %>% 
  mutate(analysis_cat = ifelse(sce$cluster_category == "Non-Epithelial" |(sce$cluster_category == "Mixed" & sce$astir_combined == "Non-Epithelial"),"non_tumor","tumor")) %>% 
  pull(analysis_cat)

sce$analysis_cat <- unname(sce$analysis_cat)

#color scheme for analysis_cat
analysis_cat <- setNames(c("#E41A1C", "#377EB8"),sort(unique(sce$analysis_cat)))                                                                  
metadata(sce)$colors$analysis_cat <- analysis_cat   

colData(sce) %>% as.data.frame %>% select(analysis_cat) %>% group_by(analysis_cat) %>% dplyr::count()
#473226 tumor cells
#258163 non-tumor cells

#Visualize in alluvial plot 
alluvial_wide(data = colData(sce) %>% as.data.frame %>% select(cluster_category, astir_combined, analysis_cat), 
              max_variables = 4,
              fill_by = 'all_flows',
              order_levels = c("Epithelial","Mixed","Unknown/Other","Non-Epithelial","tumor","non_tumor"))+
  theme_classic(base_size = 12, base_line_size = 0.5)

## For mixed cluster cells 
alluvial_wide(data = colData(sce) %>% as.data.frame %>% select(cluster_category, astir_combined, analysis_cat) %>% filter(cluster_category == "Mixed"), 
              max_variables = 4,
              fill_by = 'all_flows',
              order_levels = c("Epithelial","Mixed","Unknown/Other","Non-Epithelial","tumor","non_tumor"))+
  theme_classic(base_size = 12, base_line_size = 0.5)
```

### Estimate fraction of tumor cells for each image

```{r tumor cell fraction}
#Per sampleID
tumor_cell_SID <- colData(sce) %>% as.data.frame() %>% select(sample_id,analysis_cat) %>% group_by(sample_id) %>% table() %>% as.data.frame
tumor_cell_SID <- tumor_cell_SID %>% group_by(sample_id) %>% mutate(fra = ((Freq/sum(Freq))*100)) %>% filter(analysis_cat == "tumor")

ggplot(tumor_cell_SID, aes(x = analysis_cat,y = fra))+
  geom_boxplot()+
  geom_jitter(aes(color = sample_id), size = 3, position=position_jitter(w=0.1,h=0.1))+
  guides(color=FALSE)

tumor_cell_SID_cut_off <- foreach(i = 0:100, .combine = rbind) %do%{
data.frame(cut_off = i, n_PID = tumor_cell_SID %>% filter(fra > i) %>% ungroup %>% dplyr::count())
}

ggplot(tumor_cell_SID_cut_off, aes(x=cut_off,y = n))+
  geom_bar(stat = "identity",color = "black")+
  theme_classic()


#By patient
tumor_cell_PID <- colData(sce) %>% as.data.frame() %>% select(PID,analysis_cat) %>% group_by(PID) %>% table() %>% as.data.frame
tumor_cell_PID <- tumor_cell_PID %>% group_by(PID) %>% mutate(fra = ((Freq/sum(Freq))*100)) %>% filter(analysis_cat == "tumor")

ggplot(tumor_cell_PID, aes(x=analysis_cat,y = fra))+
  geom_boxplot()+
  geom_jitter(aes(color = PID, size = Freq), position=position_jitter(w=0.1,h=0.1))+
  guides(color=FALSE)+
  theme_classic()

ggplot(tumor_cell_PID, aes(x=analysis_cat,y = Freq))+
  geom_boxplot(outlier.color = NA)+
  geom_jitter(aes(color = PID, size = fra), position=position_jitter(w=0.1,h=0.1))+
  guides(color=FALSE)+
  theme_classic()

tumor_cell_PID_cut_off <- foreach(i = 0:100, .combine = rbind) %do%{
data.frame(cut_off = i, n_PID = tumor_cell_PID %>% filter(fra > i) %>% ungroup %>% dplyr::count())
}

ggplot(tumor_cell_PID_cut_off, aes(x=cut_off,y = n))+
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", color = "black")+
  theme_classic()


#Choose filter criteria
#here fraction of tumor cells per image < 10 %
SID_select_tumor_content <- tumor_cell_SID %>% filter(fra < 10) %>% pull(sample_id) %>% unfactor 

#summary(tumor_cell_PID$Freq)
sce$image_low_tumor <- sce$sample_id %in% SID_select_tumor_content
```
